steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: A Hero Has Fallen!
steps.body:
When one of your heroes falls in battle, you have a choice — flee the dungeon to save your remaining party, or fight on with fewer heroes.

Fleeing is not defeat. It's a tactical retreat that keeps your surviving heroes and all their equipment safe.

steps.speaker: Thalric
steps.title: What You Keep, What You Lose
steps.body:
If you flee:
  • All surviving heroes keep their equipment and bags
  • The first 3 shopkeeper bag slots are saved (insurance)
  • Remaining shopkeeper bag items are lost
  • Dungeon progress and unbanked loot are lost

If all heroes die (total party wipe), they're gone forever — permadeath. Sometimes retreat is the wisest choice.
